Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a salary bonus for bilingual instructional staff who use both languages in the classroom.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to bilingual instructional staff salary bonuses;and adding a new section to chapter 28A.405 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.405RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Certificated instructional staff who can demonstrate that they arefluent in two languages and use both languages in the classroominstruction of their students shall receive an annual bonus of tenpercent of the salary associated with the recipient's education andexperience on the statewide salary allocation schedule for the relevantyear. This annual bonus is provided in addition to compensationreceived under a district's salary schedule adopted in accordance withRCW 28A.405.200 and shall not be included in calculations of adistrict's average salary and associated salary limitation under RCW28A.400.200. The bonus shall not be considered earnable compensationas defined in RCW 41.32.010 or compensation earnable as defined in RCW41.40.010 and 41.35.010.
